scientific_limitations: Exact result for a six-vertex directional nearest-neighbor voter cycle with one opposite fixed opinion of each type and positive uniform copying rates. A special-case analytical classification, not a general social-network policy theorem; specialized priority risk remains.
title: Three sharp optimal-placement regimes in a directional six-voter ring
